description: Create a new design with our image model, fitted to the product (aspect ratio, transparent background for clothing). Use this instead of generating an image yourself: only designs from this tool can be printed. Takes about 45 seconds.

description.description: Rich description of the image: subject, pose, style, colours, mood
description.title: Description

real_subject.description: Only for a real, existing building, monument, bridge, windmill, church or recognisable place the user names: its name and town, e.g. 'Poldertoren Emmeloord'. The engine looks up a photo of it and draws the real one. Not for the user's own house, pet or people: ask for a photo.
real_subject.title: Real Subject

reference_photo.description: Design id of a photo the user uploaded that shows what the subject really looks like (their dog, their house, or a photo of the building)
reference_photo.title: Reference Photo

text.description: Exact text on the design, only if the user wants text
text.title: Text

name: create_design
title: Create design
